text.p: A stake of 2.5 million shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom sold at auction on Wednesday at an average 1,873.40 roubles ($0.340) a share, down from 2,071.44 roubles at the previous auction on November 20, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said.
Since auctions began in March 1996, 237.5 million shares, equivalent to 1.00 percent of the capital, have changed hands, the FFK said.
Prices have risen from an average 406.60 roubles a share at the first auction on March 6. The shares reached a record average 3,015.78 roubles at the auction on October 21.
Gazprom is one of Russia's biggest companies by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid because of company restrictions on selling them.
The company has organised the auctions to create an orderly market in its paper.
Gazprom was $0.367 at 1440 GMT on Wednesday on the Russian Trading System, up from $0.365 on Tuesday.
Its American Depositary Shares were unchanged at $17.90. One ADS is equivalent to 10 ordinary shares.
The next auction will be held on December 4, when 10 million shares in 40 lots will be offered at a price not exceeding 1,968 roubles a share.
